channel.title: Rust Development Updates
channel.description: AI-summarized daily Rust development updates from Facepunch source-control commits.

item.title: Today's Rust Updates — Oct 12
item.description:
78 development commits

✨ NEW — LAST 3 HRS

  • Added petting reactions, moo/baa sounds, and scratch gestures for cows and sheep; fixed gesture duration, added foot stomp and head shake sounds, and improved animal facing toward the player.
  • Sounds from destroyed monument entities are now cleared, eliminating lingering audio after removal.

Combat & Targeting

  • Hidden players now rank behind visible players for targeting, but can still be selected when no visible players are present.
  • PT boat targeting logic fixed: boats no longer give up on targets above sea level.
  • Lasers now work in first‑person view.

Livestock Interaction

  • Added petting reactions, moo/baa sounds, and scratch gestures for cows and sheep; fixed gesture duration, added foot stomp and head shake sounds, and improved animal facing toward the player.

Controls & Input

  • Gamepad stick input ignored when not the active device, fixing stick‑drift for mouse/keyboard players.
  • Gamepad duck‑latching reworked to affect only gamepad logic, fixing escape menu input clearing bug.

Items, Loot & Economy

  • Halloween DLC items fixed: lights are now craftable with correct stack size and cost, and the alien suit now blocks legs instead of the torso.
  • Magazine drops unified with the glass AK system and handling cleaned up.
  • Triangle spiral stairs now include the upkeep component, restoring proper upkeep costs.

Environment & World

  • Arctic biome refrigeration threshold increased to 10% to prevent refrigeration in tiny arctic patches.
  • Sounds from destroyed monument entities are now cleared, eliminating lingering audio after removal.

item.title: Yesterday's Rust Updates — Oct 11
item.description:
30 development commits

Structures

  • Chainlink gates now open at normal speed instead of being twice as slow.

Cosmetics

  • Spraycan reskin now correctly applies the chosen material on low‑quality double doors.

Vehicles & Mounts

  • Vehicle mount points can now be sized and overlapped, allowing a large flatbed mount to replace two small mounts; you can still load two sheep but not two cows.

Livestock & Farming

  • Livestock will now eat from troughs even when grass is present, and the amount of grass reduces the food value they receive.

Gameplay & Balance

  • Terrain configs now load correctly in the demo, preventing missing or broken terrain for players.
  • Building privilege checks are now cached, cutting the check time from ~4.6 ms to ~0.5 ms in large bases, reducing building lag.

item.title: Rust Updates — 2 Days Ago — Oct 10
item.description:
13 development commits

Resources & Farming

  • Apples now spawn exactly at the location of their loot container on trees, changing where they can be collected.

Gameplay & Balance

  • Fixed laserbeam job processing to correctly use current materials, preventing resource loss and ensuring builds function as intended.
